profile_text.body:
Allient Inc is a public company traded under the ticker ALNT and headquartered in Williamsville, New York, according to its registry profile. The text harvested from its website describes Alantra as an international financial services firm with over 500 professionals across EMEA, the Americas, and Asia, providing investment banking and alternative asset management services to corporations, family-owned companies, and institutional investors. The company describes its listed partnership model as combining corporate governance structures with team autonomy, and says its teams are personally invested in the firm.

No AI products or MCP servers are tracked for the company, and no lawsuits are listed against it. Its recorded litigation exposure sits in New York.

The site text describes Alantra rather than Allient Inc, so the material available covers the financial services business described there and not any AI offering.
